dogecoin.text:
5/

Memecoins are chaos spirits.
Unstable. Trickster gods.
They don’t ask for logic—they ask for vibes.
Dogecoin was never a joke.
It was a spell.

3/

Every digital cult begins with a shared delusion.
Could be QAnon.
Could be Dogecoin.
Could be a fictional frog that "knows the truth."
What matters is:
It spreads.
It binds.
It gives people meaning in a chaotic world.

1/

You can build the smartest AI in the world.
Feed it every dataset.
Train it on billions of tokens.
Fine-tune it until it speaks like a god.
And then it gets outperformed by a guy who bought dogecoin in 2013 by accident.
